title: spec/metadata-protocol: a draft change written through the MCP build door is recorded as `by: 'copilot'`; draftChanges cannot say "an MCP agent (OAuth client X) on behalf of user Y" (cloud#3302 item 5)
body:
Filing gate: ① a product defect with a named location. cloud#3302 item 5 (maintainer-directed, the 2026-10-27 MCP build batch) is not met because of a missing value in `MetadataAuthoringSurfaceSchema` (`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts:490`).

## 维护者速读

cloud 的 MCP build 入口（cloud#3302 / cloud#3345）让开发者自己的 agent 通过 `/api/v1/mcp` 写草稿，由人在 Studio「变更」里发布。卡片第 5 项要求发布的人能看到「哪个入口、哪个 OAuth 客户端、代表谁」写了这条草稿。框架现在的草稿逐键来源 `draftChanges`（#24298）只有 `copilot / studio / api` 三种来源和 `actor`，MCP 写入只能记成 `copilot`，没有客户端。本卡补上来源值和客户端归属，并让 Studio 变更抽屉显示它。

## Facts (objectstack `main`, read 2026-10-28)

- `MetadataAuthoringSurfaceSchema = z.enum(['copilot', 'studio', 'api'])` is at `protocol.zod.ts:490`. `draftChanges[].by` is that enum, and `actor` is the acting user (#24298).
- `copilot` is stated only by an in-process AI tool calling the save, never by a remote caller (`protocol.zod.ts:~1000`). The cloud MCP door's tools are in-process AI tools, so their saves record `by: 'copilot'`. That is indistinguishable from the in-app chat.
- The execution context already carries the OAuth performer for the `/mcp` door: `performedByClientId` (ADR-0090 D10 rule 4, `kernel/execution-context.zod.ts:298-315`). It is attribution only, and it is recorded in `sys_audit_log`, but not in `draftChanges`.
- cloud side (cloud#3345): `/meta/_drafts` `updatedBy` is the token user, which is asserted. The tool context carries `authoringDoor: 'mcp'` and `mcpPrincipal { userId, clientId, organizationId }`, ready to pass into the save.

## Done looks like

1. The draft save can record, in-process only, that a change came through the MCP door and which OAuth client performed it: a new surface value (for example `mcp`) and an optional client attribution on the `draftChanges` entry. The exact shape is the spec owner's call. It stays refused from `?surface=` over HTTP, the way `copilot` is.
2. Studio's changes drawer and properties source line render it, for example 「由 MCP 客户端 <client name> 代表 <user> 作为草稿加入」, in all locales.
3. A follow-up cloud half (cloud#3302 stays open, `Blocked-by:` this card) passes `surface` and the client from the MCP door's tool context into `saveMetaItem`.

## Out of scope

Who may write through the door (cloud#3299 and #3303), and any change to authorization. This card is attribution only.

Dedup: #24298 (closed; the per-key provenance this extends), #26587 (closed; consent copy for `metadata:write`). There is no open card on draft attribution for MCP.

Reader: the spec/metadata-protocol lane plus Studio (ui). Routed `domain:cloud` by involvement (pm-dispatch #26972).
